# Provenance

This rule originates from an incident on 2026-07-19 in which the `deploy-staging` job restored a stale cache entry, causing the pipeline to serve a build from the previous week (Source 2, 14:02–14:07). The root cause was identified through bisection: the cache key relied only on branch name and omitted the lockfile hash, so changes to dependencies went undetected (Source 2, 14:31; Source 1). The fix—adding the lockfile hash to the cache key—was validated and resolved the issue (Source 2, 14:31). Approximately 40 minutes were lost to diagnosis and remediation (Source 2, 14:44; Source 1). This was the first observed instance of this failure mode in the deployment pipeline.
